name: dropdown
title: Dropdown
description: A dropdown menu component built on Radix UI with items, groups, labels, sub-menus, and directional animations. Uses namespace exports: Dropdown.Root, Dropdown.Trigger, Dropdown.Content, Dropdown.Item, Dropdown.ItemIcon, Dropdown.Group, Dropdown.Label, Dropdown.MenuSub, Dropdown.MenuSubTrigger, Dropdown.MenuSubContent.

docs.lead: A dropdown menu component with items, groups, sub-menus, and directional slide animations.

examples.title: Demo
examples.description: Dropdown with user profile, menu items, and footer.

examples.title: Sub Menu
examples.description: Dropdown with nested sub-menus for hierarchical navigation.

api.name: Dropdown.Root
api.description: The root dropdown container. Passes through Radix DropdownMenu.Root props.

api.name: Dropdown.Trigger
api.description: The element that opens the dropdown.

props.name: asChild
props.description: Render as child element using Radix Slot

api.name: Dropdown.Content
api.description: The dropdown content panel with animations.

props.name: side
props.description: The preferred side to position the dropdown

props.name: align
props.description: The alignment relative to the trigger

props.name: sideOffset
props.description: Distance in pixels from the trigger

props.name: inset
props.description: Add left padding for alignment with icon items

api.name: Dropdown.ItemIcon
api.description: Icon displayed inside a dropdown item.

api.name: Dropdown.Label
api.description: A label for a group of dropdown items.

api.name: Dropdown.MenuSubTrigger
api.description: The item that opens a sub-menu. Shows a right arrow indicator.
